title: 28 Sept-Youth Month Program -Drawing Painting Comp
summary: 28th September – Drawing & Painting Competition at SL & SS Girls High School (Junior and Senior Students), Thakurdwar.
description:
28th September – Drawing & Painting Competition at SL & SS Girls High School (Junior and Senior Students), Thakurdwar.
On 28th September, from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., we started with our Drawing & Painting Competition, with an impressive 186 students participating. Frooti, bananas and biscuits were distributed to all the students, teachers and parents, while some students were also provided with sketch pens, water colours, pencils and rulers. The paintings were truly beautiful and showcased an extraordinary level of creativity, imagination and talent. While we often speak of providing children from marginalised communities with opportunities and exposure, we are often left astounded by the quality and talent they themselves display—work that could easily stand alongside that of students from some of the best schools. Many thanks to Rtn Shivprasad Khator and Rtn Navnath Panaskar for their effort and dedication in making this flagship project a success.
